nodes.label: AMPM Platform Data Model and ER Diagrams
nodes.rationale: DRAFT v0.2, 25 October 2026, not signed off. Extends AMPM Developer Technical Specification v1.0 §3 (module inventory) and §4 (suggested relational data model): §4 table names kept where they existed, new tables cover the records §3 names but §4 does not model. 108 tables (two dormant) against 35 rows in SPEC §4. Each module has a Mermaid erDiagram showing key fields only; field comments carry RESTRICTED / SENSITIVE / CLIENT visibility markers; design choices depending on unanswered questions are tagged with assumption IDs A-n that cite audit questions Q-n.

nodes.label: Requirements Audit (requirements-audit.md)
nodes.rationale: Companion document: audit findings (GP-n gaps, AM-n ambiguities) and the Q numbers that the data model's assumptions depend on.

nodes.label: Permission Matrix (permission-matrix.md)
nodes.rationale: Companion document: who may read and write what; holds the full status lists (§7), the automation list (§8), the audited entities (§9) and the entitlement table (§3).

nodes.label: Decision Log (decision-log.md)
nodes.rationale: Records every AMPM answer of 25 October 2026; §0a of the data model lists the ones that change the model.

nodes.label: Architecture (architecture.md)
nodes.rationale: Referenced as 'architecture §0a' for the offline change queue of the native apps and for real-time chat delivery.

nodes.label: AMPM Developer Technical Specification v1.0 (SPEC)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth being extended. §3 module inventory, §4 suggested relational data model (35 rows) with a security note that client-facing and internal amounts must never share one column, §5 project creation minimums, §6 eleven roles, §7 statuses, §8 automation, §9 reports and exports, §10 configurability, §11 phases, §12 version locking and sharing rules, §15 project as parent.

nodes.label: AMPM Business Rules (BIZ)
nodes.rationale: Rule 8: do not invent business policies, so every assumption is a placeholder for AMPM's answer, not a recommendation on price or policy. §2.A: the private hotel database is never queried by public pages. §2.C: vendor negotiations must not be visible to clients.

nodes.label: Assumptions register (§0)
nodes.rationale: Thirty assumptions A-1..A-30, each stating the default adopted, the audit question it depends on, AMPM's 25 October 2026 position (confirmed / changed / partly decided / still open / not addressed) and what changes in the model if AMPM decides otherwise.

nodes.label: Changes from AMPM's decisions of 25 October 2026 (§0a)
nodes.rationale: Decisions that changed the model: Q9 indicative price ranges, wedding packages, street view; Q2 couple_names and preferred_locations at activation; Q5 two family representatives; Q7 RSVP link scope, self-identification, locked responses, correction requests; Q20 live chat module Q; Q8/Q17 no automatic deletion; Q23 three-month access window and archived_by; Q4 vendor_assignments.share_contact; Q21 closed status; Q3 call_request activity; Q12 CMS dormant; Q16 GST dormant; Q1 native apps need no table changes.

nodes.label: Modelling conventions (§1)
nodes.rationale: Keys, standard columns, money, statuses, reference tables, versioned records, visibility, polymorphic references, audit, demo isolation and time conventions that apply to every table and are not repeated in the diagrams.

nodes.label: UUID v7 primary keys and FK naming
nodes.rationale: Every table has id UUID v7 (time-ordered). Foreign keys are named <table_singular>_id. Human-readable codes such as the wedding code AMPM-2027-014 are separate unique columns, never primary keys.

nodes.label: Standard columns and soft delete
nodes.rationale: created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at on every table. Wedding, guest and finance records are never hard-deleted; physical deletion happens only through retention jobs (A-17), which after Q17 produce proposals awaiting AMPM approval.

nodes.label: Client-facing and internal amounts in separate columns
nodes.rationale: amount is numeric(14,2) with a sibling currency (ISO 4217, default INR, A-16). Client-facing and internal amounts are always separate columns, never one column with a flag, per the SPEC §4 security note, because AMPM may earn a margin (A-4) and clients must never see internal cost or margin. Applied on vendor_proposals, hotel_proposals, budget_lines, room_blocks and project_final_accounts.

nodes.label: Statuses fixed in code, labels configurable
nodes.rationale: Statuses are fixed enumerations in code because automation depends on them (SPEC §8); display labels are configurable through configurations. Full status lists and transitions live in the permission matrix §7.

nodes.label: Super Admin editable reference tables
nodes.rationale: lead_sources, plans, service_types, function_types, budget_categories, vendor_categories and checklist_templates are editable by Super Admin so SPEC §10 'configurable packages, categories, statuses and pricing' holds without code changes.

nodes.label: Versioned records immutable once shared
nodes.rationale: design_versions, menu_versions, invitation_versions, vendor_proposals and hotel_proposals are immutable once shared. A new version supersedes the old one and approvals point at the exact version (SPEC §12).

nodes.label: RESTRICTED / SENSITIVE / CLIENT field markers
nodes.rationale: RESTRICTED: internal only, server-side guarded. SENSITIVE: guest health or identity data. CLIENT: client-visible when the owning record is shared. Unmarked fields are internal by default and become client-visible only through the permission matrix rules.

nodes.label: Visibility follows the owning record
nodes.rationale: documents.visibility and media_assets.visibility are enumerations (internal, client, guest, public, demo). Everything else follows the owning record: a file attached to a vendor proposal is client-visible only if the proposal is shared and the user is a member of that project. The API enforces this on every request and every export (SPEC §6.1, §9).

nodes.label: Polymorphic references limited to six tables
nodes.rationale: owner_type+owner_id, entity_type+entity_id and record_type+record_id are used only for documents, media, comments, approvals, audit events and notifications, each with a check constraint on the allowed types. Open question §21.4 keeps one polymorphic comments table rather than per-entity tables (cleaner indexing versus multiplied code).

nodes.label: Append-only, monthly partitioned audit
nodes.rationale: audit_events records every create, update, delete, approval, share, export and restricted-field read on the entities in permission matrix §9. Rows are append-only and partitioned by month (A-15). audit_events.project_id is denormalised so a project manager can read their own project's history without scanning everything. Open question §21.6: restricted-field reads audited for identity documents and internal cost; auditing every restricted read is possible but noisy.

nodes.label: Demo isolation at the repository layer
nodes.rationale: Queries for a demo user are scoped to is_demo = true accounts and projects and demo_visible = true hotels at the repository layer, not in the interface (A-28). Open question §21.5: demo could use invented sample hotels seeded as inactive hotels with demo_visible = true.

nodes.label: UTC storage with per-project timezone
nodes.rationale: All timestamps are stored in UTC; wedding_projects.timezone (default Asia/Kolkata) drives display (A-16, AM-13).

nodes.label: Module overview ER diagram (§2)
nodes.rationale: Core entities only: leads convert to client_accounts, which hold subscriptions, service_agreements, saved_hotels, hotel_enquiries and wedding_projects; the wedding project is the parent of functions, budget lines, vendor assignments, designs, approvals, requests, family groups, room blocks, tasks, incidents, invoices and documents.

nodes.label: Entity index with phases and restricted fields (§19)
nodes.rationale: Lists every entity with module, phase (per SPEC §11 as adjusted by A-10) and the fields or whole tables the permission matrix guards server-side. Count: 108 tables including join tables, two dormant, against 35 rows in SPEC §4.

nodes.label: Coverage against the audit (§20)
nodes.rationale: §20.1 maps the SPEC §3 records that §4 did not model to their new tables. §20.2 maps audit findings GP-1..GP-44 and AM-1..AM-15 to their resolution. Not resolved by a data model: GP-4 recurring billing scope, GP-7 refunds, GP-28 calendar sync, GP-33..GP-40 non-functional and compliance items, GP-42 and GP-43 hosting.

nodes.label: Open modelling questions for review (§21)
nodes.rationale: 1 client-visible actuals (budget_lines.actual_amount CLIENT by default, Q4); 2 vendor contacts after selection via per-assignment share_contact (Q4, Q22); 3 guest contact details visible to the client even when AMPM adds guests (Q7); 4 one polymorphic comments table versus per-entity tables; 5 real demo hotels with masked rates versus invented sample hotels (A-28); 6 audit granularity for restricted-field reads; 7 monthly partitioning of audit_events and notifications, indexing of guest_function_attendance, revisit if volumes exceed A-15.

nodes.label: Module A — Identity, access and administration
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Administration (user, role, permission, notification, audit event, configuration) and adds auth_tokens, notification_preferences and import_jobs. Staff get global roles through user_roles; their reach into a wedding is limited by project_members for the roles the spec marks 'assigned' (Project Manager, Creative, Vendor Coordinator, RSVP, Hospitality). Client users are ordinary users rows with user_type = client and a project_members row per wedding.

nodes.label: Module B — CRM, subscriptions and commercial agreements
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 CRM/subscriptions; resolves audit GP-2 (trial), GP-3 (plans and module entitlements), GP-5 (hotel-assistance commercial flow), GP-6 (milestone payments), GP-17 (payment direction).

nodes.label: Module C — Hotel intelligence
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Hotel intelligence; resolves GP-8 (prices), GP-9 (availability), GP-10 (saved hotels), GP-20 (media rights), AM-5 (room capacity). media_assets is defined in module N.

nodes.label: Module D — Hotel consultancy
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Hotel consultancy (availability enquiry, response, negotiation, site visit, proposal, booking milestone), which SPEC §4 modelled only as hotel_enquiries. Resolves GP-5 and the acceptance test 'AMPM records negotiation and site visit without exposing internal notes'.

nodes.label: Module E — Wedding project
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Wedding project (project, client contacts, scope, team assignment); resolves GP-12 (several hotels and venues outside the database) and GP-1 (post-closure access window). project_members is defined in module A.

nodes.label: Module F — Functions, programme and run-of-show
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Functions (function, schedule, checklist, venue, run-of-show). Readiness checklist uses the generic checklist tables of module O. Resolves AM-2 (venue typing) and AM-3 (status versus readiness).

nodes.label: Module G — Budget and finance
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Budget/finance (budget category, line, quote, contract, invoice, payment, cost entry) and the Closure final account. Resolves GP-17 (client versus internal invoices), GP-18 (GST), GP-19 (reference tables) and implements A-4. payments is in module B, vendor_quotes in module H.

nodes.label: Module H — Vendors, artists and production
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Vendors and the artist, technical rider and production item records of Food/entertainment/production. Resolves GP-21 (vendor availability) and the vendor decision field of SPEC §5. Vendor portfolios are media_assets with owner_type = vendor.

nodes.label: Module I — Creative, approvals and client requests
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Creative/approvals (design brief, version, comment, approval, change request). Resolves GP-14 (change requests), GP-15 (questions), AM-7 (multiple approvers) and implements A-20, A-21, A-25.

nodes.label: Module J — Invitations, guests and RSVP
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Invitations/RSVP (invitation, recipient, guest, family group, response, attendance) and the guest request record of Rooms/logistics/hospitality. Resolves GP-13 (guest is the atomic unit), GP-16, GP-24 (dietary data), AM-1 (tokens per family group) and implements A-7. Identity documents are in module N.

nodes.label: Module K — Rooms, travel and transport
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Rooms/logistics/hospitality (room allocation, travel segment, transfer, vehicle) and the departure and lost-and-found records of Closure. Resolves GP-11 (room blocks) and implements A-19.

nodes.label: Module L — Menus and food service
nodes.rationale: Covers the menu version record of SPEC §3 Food/entertainment/production and resolves GP-24 (headcounts by dietary category).

nodes.label: Module M — Tasks, staffing and incidents
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §3 Tasks/risk (task, dependency, staff assignment, incident, resolution). Resolves GP-30 (staffing). Incident updates use the generic comments table of module I.

nodes.label: Module N — Documents, media and identity documents
nodes.rationale: Covers SPEC §4 documents/media, split into files with versions (documents) and gallery media with rights (media_assets). Resolves GP-20 (media rights), GP-41 (Aadhaar) and implements A-8 and A-17.

nodes.label: Module O — Checklists, closure and feedback
nodes.rationale: Covers the checklist, readiness check and closure records of SPEC §3 and the feedback step in the team flowchart (GP-29). The same two tables serve function readiness and project closure.

nodes.label: Module P — Public website content (dormant)
nodes.rationale: AMPM decided on 25 October 2026 (Q12) that staff will not edit website content through the app. cms_pages and cms_showcase_items are kept in the model so the decision is reversible but are not built; the public website is maintained outside the platform.

nodes.label: Module Q — Live chat
nodes.rationale: Added for AMPM's decision that live chat is required alongside tracked requests (Q20). A conversation is a lightweight thread for immediate help; anything needing an approval history becomes a client_requests row, which a message can link to. Delivery is real time (architecture §0a); unanswered conversations surface on the team dashboard.

nodes.label: users
nodes.rationale: Staff, client and demo logins. user_type enum staff/client/demo (A-13, A-22; no vendor value). status invited/active/disabled/locked. password_hash RESTRICTED and nullable for OTP-only sign-in; mfa_enabled mandatory true for staff; mfa_secret_ref RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: roles
nodes.rationale: Global staff roles. role_key: super_admin, sales, hotel_team, project_manager, creative, vendor_coordinator, rsvp_team, hospitality, finance; is_system flag. Role changes alter seed data only (A-6).

nodes.label: permissions
nodes.rationale: permission_key follows module.resource.action and optionally .scope, e.g. budget.internal_cost.read; the permission matrix lists them.

nodes.label: role_permissions
nodes.rationale: Join table role_id x permission_id.

nodes.label: user_roles
nodes.rationale: Join table user_id x role_id; staff get global roles through it.

nodes.label: project_members
nodes.rationale: Per-wedding staff and client membership. project_role enum project_lead/staff/client_representative (A-5 changed by Q5: two representatives per wedding, one per side); client_side bride/groom; can_view_finance and can_approve are configuration, both true for representatives (pending Q4); status invited/active/removed.

nodes.label: auth_tokens
nodes.rationale: Invites, resets, OTP and magic links. purpose enum invite/password_reset/otp/magic_link; token_hash RESTRICTED; expires_at, used_at. Carries the OTP flow required by Q13 (A-13).

nodes.label: notifications
nodes.rationale: Delivery log. recipient_type user/guest; channel enum in_app/email/whatsapp/sms/push (A-11); template_key; polymorphic entity_type/entity_id; status queued/sent/delivered/failed/read; provider_ref. Partitioned monthly (§21.7).

nodes.label: notification_preferences
nodes.rationale: Per user, event_type and channel enabled flag.

nodes.label: audit_events
nodes.rationale: Append-only change history. actor_user_id, actor_type user/guest_token/system; action create/update/delete/approve/share/export/restricted_read; polymorphic entity; project_id nullable and denormalised for project-scoped queries; before_json/after_json; ip_address; occurred_at. Partitioned by month (A-15). Also the change history for room allocations and the mirror of the native apps' offline change queue on sync.

nodes.label: configurations
nodes.rationale: Thresholds, labels and escalation rules. config_key UK e.g. hotel_verification_max_age_days, material_change_threshold_pct; value_json; scope global/project with scope_id.

nodes.label: import_jobs
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheet imports. import_type enum hotels/guests/vendors (A-9, GP-22); project_id required for guests; file_document_id; status uploaded/validating/failed/applied; row_count; error_report_json.

nodes.label: lead_sources
nodes.rationale: Reference table: website, instagram, advertisement, referral, call, other; is_active.

nodes.label: leads
nodes.rationale: Enquiry pipeline. status new/contacted/introduction_shared/demo_offered/demo_accessed/follow_up/converted/closed; contact_preference phone/whatsapp/email; tentative dates; destination_id or destination_text free text; guest_estimate; consent_marketing/consent_at; requested_demo; owner_user_id; converted_account_id/converted_at; closed_reason. The public enquiry form writes here; a demo request sets requested_demo = true.

nodes.label: lead_activities
nodes.rationale: Follow-up log. activity_type enum call/email/whatsapp/meeting/consultation/demo/questionnaire/call_request/note (AM-15; call_request added for the pre-purchase Zoom call, Q3); questionnaire_json holds structured answers; next_follow_up_at.

nodes.label: client_accounts
nodes.rationale: Client account (couple or family name). couple_names and preferred_locations entered at activation (Q2); is_demo (A-28); status prospect/active/suspended/closed; primary_contact_user_id; lead_id; billing_name/address; gstin optional for B2B invoicing; internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: account_contacts
nodes.rationale: Family contacts on an account: relation (bride, groom, father of the bride), phone, email, is_decision_maker, user_id nullable when the contact has a login.

nodes.label: plans
nodes.rationale: Packages. plan_type hotel_discovery/trial/demo/package; billing_type one_time/recurring (A-3); price_amount set by AMPM, never hard-coded (Q3: Rs 50,000 one-time one month, configurable); term_days; trial_days; is_demo; status draft/active/retired; terms_version.

nodes.label: plan_modules
nodes.rationale: Module entitlements per plan. module_key enum hotel_discovery/hotel_assistance/wedding_workspace/guest_rsvp/documents; access_level read/full (GP-3).

nodes.label: subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Trial and paid hotel-discovery access. status trial/pending_payment/active/expiring/expired/suspended/cancelled (GP-2); starts_at/ends_at/trial_ends_at; auto_renew; activation_source gateway_webhook/manual (A-2); activated_by_user_id; cancel_reason. Belongs to an account and covers every project on it (A-29).

nodes.label: service_types
nodes.rationale: Reference table. service_key: availability_check, negotiation, site_visit, contract_review, booking_assistance, design, vendor_coordination, full_management; category hotel_assistance/design/vendor_coordination/full_management/other.

nodes.label: service_agreements
nodes.rationale: Paid services beyond the subscription. project_id nullable until a project exists; hotel_enquiry_id links hotel assistance to its enquiry (GP-5); scope_text; fee_amount set by AMPM (Q4); fee_structure fixed/percentage/milestones; terms_version; status draft/sent/accepted/active/completed/cancelled; accepted_by_user_id; document_id.

nodes.label: payment_milestones
nodes.rationale: Payment stages for engagements (GP-6). due_date, amount, status pending/invoiced/paid/overdue/waived, invoice_id. Online milestone payment is out of the first release (Q4).

nodes.label: payments
nodes.rationale: Inbound and outbound money movements in one table. direction inbound/outbound (GP-17); counterparty_type client/vendor/hotel/other; purpose subscription/service_fee/milestone/vendor_payment/hotel_payment/refund; related_type subscription/invoice/payment_milestone; method gateway/bank_transfer/upi/cheque/cash; provider/provider_ref; status initiated/pending/succeeded/failed/refunded/cancelled; refund_of_payment_id; client_visible true only for inbound client payments (A-4). Subscription activation keys off status = succeeded (A-2).

nodes.label: destinations
nodes.rationale: Destination catalogue. slug UK, region, state, country, description, status draft/active/inactive, public_visible (shown on the public website), hero_media_id.

nodes.label: hotels
nodes.rationale: Hotel profile. destination_id; slug; brand; star_category; address; latitude/longitude; description_client CLIENT; status draft/active/inactive; demo_visible (A-28); public_showcase (approved for the public website); internal_rating and internal_notes RESTRICTED; total_rooms; street_view_ref (Q9); last_verified_at denormalised from hotel_verifications. About 200 hotels at the start, updated about three times a year (A-9, A-15).

nodes.label: hotel_contacts
nodes.rationale: Hotel sales contacts. RESTRICTED table because clients contact hotels through AMPM. name, role_title, phone, email, is_primary.

nodes.label: hotel_room_categories
nodes.rationale: Room inventory by category. room_count is the inventory in the category, max_occupancy is per room (A-27, AM-5); size_sqm; facilities_json.

nodes.label: hotel_venues
nodes.rationale: Event spaces. venue_type ballroom/lawn/poolside/rooftop/courtyard/beach/other; is_indoor; area_sqm; capacity_banquet/theatre/reception; facilities_json.

nodes.label: hotel_rate_cards
nodes.rationale: Indicative commercials per hotel and season, e.g. 'Wedding season 2027'. valid_from/valid_to; currency; status draft/verified/stale/retired; verification_id; source RESTRICTED (e.g. hotel sales email); internal_notes RESTRICTED. Marked stale by a scheduled job when its verification is older than configurations.hotel_verification_max_age_days.

nodes.label: hotel_rate_items
nodes.rationale: Rate card line items. item_type enum room_rate/venue_rental/per_plate_veg/per_plate_non_veg/wedding_package/beverage_package/service_charge/tax/other (A-9, Q9); room_category_id and venue_id nullable; amount is the lower bound of a range or the single indicative value; amount_max upper bound nullable (Q9); is_indicative true for ranges shown to clients (confirmed quotations live in hotel_proposals); unit per_night/per_plate/per_event/percent; min_quantity; inclusions_text; client_visible CLIENT when true and the card is verified.

nodes.label: hotel_verifications
nodes.rationale: Freshness of each hotel field group; the source of truth for freshness. field_group profile/rooms/venues/rates/availability/media/contacts; verified_at/verified_by; source phone/email/site_visit/website/contract; status verified/unverified/stale; next_due_at = verified_at plus configurable age. 'availability' records when AMPM last confirmed general availability for a season (GP-9).

nodes.label: hotel_wedding_references
nodes.rationale: Past weddings at the hotel. project_id nullable (the AMPM wedding it refers to); event_year; guest_count; description_client CLIENT; client_visible; consent_document_id from the referenced client (GP-20).

nodes.label: saved_hotels
nodes.rationale: Client shortlist (GP-10), unique on (account_id, hotel_id); project_id nullable, back-filled when linked to a wedding (GP-27); saved_by_user_id; note. 'Compare hotels' is a view over this table.

nodes.label: hotel_enquiries
nodes.rationale: Assistance requests and consultancy; the ten-status flow draft/submitted/awaiting_hotel/response_received/negotiating/visit_scheduled/proposal_received/client_decision/confirmed/closed. project_id nullable before a project exists; requested_by_user_id; assigned_user_id; service_agreement_id nullable (GP-5); date_from/to; dates_flexible; guest_estimate; rooms_required; functions_summary CLIENT; notes_client CLIENT; notes_internal RESTRICTED; outcome booked/declined/no_availability/withdrawn. Date-specific availability is answered inside an enquiry (GP-9).

nodes.label: hotel_enquiry_events
nodes.rationale: Enquiry timeline. event_type submitted/sent_to_hotel/hotel_response/negotiation_note/client_update/status_change/visit/proposal; occurred_at; user_id; summary; internal_only true hides the event from the client entirely; document_id.

nodes.label: site_visits
nodes.rationale: Scheduled hotel visits. scheduled_at; status proposed/confirmed/completed/cancelled; attendees_text; outcome_internal RESTRICTED; client_feedback CLIENT.

nodes.label: hotel_proposals
nodes.rationale: Negotiated offers shown to the client, versioned. version_number; status draft/shared/revision_requested/accepted/declined/superseded; valid_until; client_total_amount CLIENT and internal_total_amount RESTRICTED (hotel net or commission basis, A-4); document_id; shared_at; decided_at/decided_by_user_id; approval_id locks the exact version; supersedes_proposal_id. Client sees proposals in shared or later status with client amounts only.

nodes.label: hotel_proposal_lines
nodes.rationale: Proposal line items. item_type uses the same enumeration as hotel_rate_items; description; quantity; unit_amount; total_amount; client_visible.

nodes.label: booking_milestones
nodes.rationale: Hold, contract, advance, confirmation. milestone_type hold_placed/contract_sent/contract_signed/advance_paid/rooming_list_due/balance_due/confirmed; due_at/completed_at; status pending/done/overdue/cancelled; amount; contract_id; document_id. An enquiry reaches confirmed only when the confirmed milestone is completed and a contract exists.

nodes.label: wedding_projects
nodes.rationale: Parent of all wedding records (SPEC §15). code UK AMPM-YYYY-NNN generated; account_id; status setup/planning/approvals/pre_production/ready/live/closure/closed/on_hold; date_from/to; dates_tentative (SPEC §5); destination_id; primary_hotel_id convenience pointer only (A-18); guest_estimate(_confirmed); timezone default Asia/Kolkata (A-16); currency; primary_service_agreement_id; project_lead_user_id; is_demo (A-28); on_hold_reason; closed_at; archived_at set on AMPM approval and archived_by (A-24, Q23); client_access_until = closed_at plus three months (Q23); internal_notes RESTRICTED. Creating it needs only name, account and a tentative date range.

nodes.label: project_hotels
nodes.rationale: Hotels used by the wedding. hotel_role primary/overflow/venue_only (A-18); notes. A single-hotel wedding has one row.

nodes.label: external_venues
nodes.rationale: Venues outside the hotel database (GP-12). name, address, contact_name and contact_phone RESTRICTED, capacity, notes.

nodes.label: function_types
nodes.rationale: Reference table: mehendi, haldi, sangeet, ceremony, reception, brunch, other; sort_order; is_active.

nodes.label: functions
nodes.rationale: Events within the wedding. function_type_id; name CLIENT; function_date; start/end_time; venue_kind hotel_venue/external_venue/tbd with two optional foreign keys hotel_venue_id and external_venue_id (AM-2); guest_estimate; theme and dress_code CLIENT; status planned/confirmed/cancelled and readiness_status not_started/in_progress/blocked/ready/live/completed derived from the checklist (A-26, AM-3); readiness_exception_note and readiness_exception_by for documented authorised exceptions (SPEC §7); internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: function_programme_items
nodes.rationale: Shared programme the client and guests may see. start/end_time; title and description CLIENT; client_visible default true.

nodes.label: run_of_show_items
nodes.rationale: Internal cue sheet. sequence; planned_start/end; cue; description; owner_user_id; vendor_assignment_id nullable; status pending/in_progress/done/skipped; actual_start/end; notes. Internal only (SPEC §2.4).

nodes.label: budget_categories
nodes.rationale: Reference table with category_key UK, parent_id hierarchy, sort_order, is_active (GP-19).

nodes.label: budget_lines
nodes.rationale: Estimate, approved, actual and internal cost per line. function_id nullable; category_id; title and description CLIENT; estimate_amount, approved_amount (locked by approval) and actual_amount (billed to the client) CLIENT; internal_cost_estimate and internal_cost_actual RESTRICTED (A-4); status draft/proposed/approved/committed/invoiced/paid/closed; vendor_assignment_id, hotel_enquiry_id, approval_id nullable; client_visible; internal_notes RESTRICTED. Open question §21.1: whether actual_amount stays client-visible.

nodes.label: cost_entries
nodes.rationale: Internal actual costs, RESTRICTED table. budget_line_id; vendor_assignment_id nullable; description; amount; incurred_at; invoice_id (vendor invoice) and payment_id (outbound payment) nullable.

nodes.label: contracts
nodes.rationale: Client, vendor and hotel contracts. project_id nullable for account-level client contracts; party_type client/vendor/hotel with party_id; vendor_assignment_id and hotel_enquiry_id nullable; amount; start/end_date; status draft/sent/signed/active/completed/terminated; signed_at; document_id; client_visible true for client contracts, false for vendor and hotel contracts (A-4); internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: invoices
nodes.rationale: Issued and received invoices, split by direction not by dual amounts. direction issued_to_client/received_from_vendor/received_from_hotel (GP-17); counterparty; invoice_number UK; issue/due_date; subtotal, tax_rate (GST, A-16), tax_amount, total; supplier_gstin, recipient_gstin, place_of_supply (GP-18, dormant after Q16); status draft/issued/partially_paid/paid/overdue/cancelled/credited; payment_milestone_id nullable; document_id; client_visible only when direction is issued_to_client.

nodes.label: invoice_lines
nodes.rationale: Invoice items. description; budget_line_id nullable; hsn_sac_code (GST); quantity; unit_amount; tax_rate; line_total.

nodes.label: project_final_accounts
nodes.rationale: Closure reconciliation, one row per project created at closure and approved by Finance before the project can close. total_client_billed; total_client_paid; total_vendor_cost, total_hotel_cost and margin_amount RESTRICTED; status draft/reconciled/approved/closed; reconciled_by; approved_by; document_id.

nodes.label: vendor_categories
nodes.rationale: Reference table. category_key: decor, photography, videography, sound_light, artists, catering, tents_props, sfx, transport, other; parent_id; is_active.

nodes.label: vendors
nodes.rationale: Vendor master. name CLIENT when presented; primary_category_id; description_client CLIENT; contact_name, phone and email RESTRICTED (clients deal with vendors through AMPM, BIZ §2.C); website; instagram_handle; base_city; service_area; status prospective/active/preferred/inactive/blacklisted; internal_rating and internal_notes RESTRICTED; gstin; bank_details_document_id RESTRICTED; onboarded_at. Vendors never log in (A-22).

nodes.label: vendor_category_links
nodes.rationale: Join table vendor_id x category_id for additional categories a vendor offers.

nodes.label: vendor_availability
nodes.rationale: Verified availability windows (GP-21). date_from/to; status available/tentative/booked/unavailable; verified_at/verified_by; source; note.

nodes.label: vendor_assignments
nodes.rationale: Options, decisions and delivery per wedding. function_id nullable; vendor_id; category_id; scope_text CLIENT; status option/shortlisted/selected/contracted/delivering/completed/cancelled/declined; client_decision none/interested/shortlisted/selected/declined with client_decision_at/by (SPEC §5); presented_at (the client sees the option from here); contract_id nullable; completion_confirmed_at/by (vendor completion for closure); share_contact true only in an AMPM-approved case (Q4); internal_notes RESTRICTED. Five to ten options per category is a guideline, not a constraint.

nodes.label: vendor_quotes
nodes.rationale: Raw quotes sent by vendors to AMPM, RESTRICTED table. vendor_id; project_id; vendor_assignment_id nullable; version_number; amount; received_at; valid_until; document_id; status received/shortlisted/selected/rejected/expired; internal_notes.

nodes.label: vendor_proposals
nodes.rationale: Versioned proposals AMPM shows the client. version_number; title, description_client and inclusions_text CLIENT; client_visible_amount CLIENT and internal_cost RESTRICTED (A-4); status draft/shared/revision_requested/accepted/declined/superseded; shared_at; decided_at/decided_by_user_id; approval_id points at the approval that locked that exact version; document_id; supersedes_proposal_id.

nodes.label: vendor_deliverables
nodes.rationale: Delivery tracking and acceptance. function_id nullable; title; due_at; status pending/in_progress/delivered/accepted/rejected; accepted_by/accepted_at. completion_confirmed_at on the assignment is set when all deliverables are accepted.

nodes.label: artist_bookings
nodes.rationale: Performers, slots and riders. artist_name CLIENT; performance_type; slot_start/end; status enquiry/held/confirmed/performed/cancelled; technical_rider_document_id; hospitality_requirements; travel_arrangements; fee_internal RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: production_items
nodes.rationale: Sound, light, stage, tents and effects. category sound/lighting/stage/led/tent/props/sfx/power/other; description; quantity; status planned/ordered/delivered/installed/tested/struck; owner_user_id; checklist_item_id nullable links to a readiness item.

nodes.label: design_items
nodes.rationale: Versioned creative work. function_id nullable; category concept/moodboard/render/invitation/save_the_date/stationery/signage/other; title CLIENT; brief_text (the design brief); status briefing/in_progress/review/approved/archived; owner_user_id; client_visible.

nodes.label: design_versions
nodes.rationale: Design versions, immutable once shared. version_number; summary CLIENT; status draft/shared/revision_requested/approved/rejected/superseded; shared_at; approval_id.

nodes.label: comments
nodes.rationale: One polymorphic threads table. entity_type enum design_version/vendor_proposal/menu_version/client_request/task/incident/hotel_enquiry; author_user_id; body; is_internal true is never client-visible; parent_comment_id; annotation_json holds an x/y pin on a design image. Also carries incident updates (module M) and internal staff notes on chat conversations.

nodes.label: client_requests
nodes.rationale: Questions, change requests and support. request_type question/change_request/support (A-20, A-21); requested_by_user_id; optional entity_type/entity_id the request is about; status submitted/under_review/clarification_requested/answered/accepted/rejected/implemented/closed/withdrawn (closed added by Q21); is_material (A-25); budget_impact_amount; impact_flags_json budget/contract/task/run_of_show (SPEC §8); assigned_user_id; responded_by/at; response_text CLIENT. Replaces both the messaging feature of the client-portal flowchart and the change-request record.

nodes.label: approvals
nodes.rationale: Version-locked decisions. record_type enum vendor_proposal/hotel_proposal/design_version/menu_version/invitation_version/budget_line/contract/client_request; record_id; version_number (the exact version locked, SPEC §12); requested_by_user_id/requested_at; required_decisions default 1 (AM-7, A-5); status draft/submitted/revision_requested/approved/rejected/superseded; decided_at; superseded_by_approval_id.

nodes.label: approval_decisions
nodes.rationale: One row per approver. decision approved/revision_requested/rejected; comment; decided_at; recorded_on_behalf_by (staff user when the decision was given offline); evidence_document_id required when recorded on behalf.

nodes.label: invitations
nodes.rationale: Save-the-dates and invitations (AM-12). invitation_type save_the_date/invitation/reminder/update; title CLIENT; design_item_id nullable; channels_json email/whatsapp/sms/print; status draft/approved/scheduled/sending/sent/closed; scheduled_at; sent_at.

nodes.label: invitation_versions
nodes.rationale: Versioned invitation content. content_media_id; message_text CLIENT; status draft/shared/approved/superseded; approval_id.

nodes.label: invitation_recipients
nodes.rationale: Distribution status per household. invitation_version_id; family_group_id; guest_id nullable (the addressee within the group); channel; status pending/sent/delivered/opened/failed/bounced; provider_ref; rsvp_token_id.

nodes.label: family_groups
nodes.rationale: Invited households, e.g. 'Mehta family, Mumbai'. side partner_a/partner_b/both/other; tier configurable (VIP, family, friends); primary_guest_id; invited_by_contact_id (the account contact who added them, GP-25); max_additional_guests default 0 (A-7); source client_list/ampm_entry/import; internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: guests
nodes.rationale: One row per person; the atomic record (GP-13). family_group_id; salutation; first_name and last_name CLIENT; relation_to_couple; age_band adult/child/infant; email, phone, whatsapp_number; city, country; is_group_primary; dietary_preference veg/non_veg/jain/vegan/eggetarian/other (GP-24); allergies_text and accessibility_needs SENSITIVE; special_requests; status draft/invited/confirmed/removed; source client_list/ampm_entry/self_added/import; identification_status not_needed/pending/matched/review for self-identification on side or wedding links (Q7); internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: guest_function_attendance
nodes.rationale: Attendance per guest per function, unique on (guest_id, function_id); headcounts are counted from these rows. is_invited; status no_response/attending/not_attending/tentative; responded_at; response_source self_service/ampm_call/client/import; updated_by. Indexed by project and function (§21.7).

nodes.label: rsvp_tokens
nodes.rationale: Tokenised RSVP links. link_scope household/side/wedding (Q7: per side or one combined link); side bride/groom/both; family_group_id nullable for side or wedding links; token_hash UK RESTRICTED; expires_at; status active/revoked/expired; last_accessed_at; access_count; revoked_at/revoked_by. Guests never have accounts (A-13).

nodes.label: rsvp_responses
nodes.rationale: Submission log. family_group_id; guest_id nullable; channel web/phone/whatsapp/email/in_person; token_id set for self-service; captured_by_user_id set for AMPM-assisted; submitted_at; payload_json immutable snapshot of what was submitted; locked true after submission, corrections go through the RSVP team (Q7); ip_address.

nodes.label: guest_support_requests
nodes.rationale: Guest tickets. request_type travel/room/dietary/accessibility/correction/general/complaint (correction added by Q7); description; status open/assigned/in_progress/resolved/closed; assigned_user_id; resolved_at; resolution_text. Allergies reach caterers only through dietary requests handled by hospitality.

nodes.label: room_blocks
nodes.rationale: Rooms held per project, hotel, category and date range (GP-11, A-19). rooms_blocked; rooms_released; release_deadline; internal_rate_amount RESTRICTED and client_rate_amount CLIENT nullable (A-4); status requested/held/contracted/partially_released/released/closed; contract_id; internal_notes RESTRICTED.

nodes.label: room_allocations
nodes.rationale: Rooming list. room_block_id nullable for ad hoc rooms (flagged in the rooming report); hotel_id; room_category_id; room_number; check_in/check_out_date; status requested/proposed/confirmed/checked_in/checked_out/cancelled; allocated_by; special_requests. Validated against rooms_blocked - rooms_released for its dates; change history comes from audit_events.

nodes.label: room_allocation_occupants
nodes.rationale: Guests in a room, children included; is_primary_occupant. Sharing rules are validations, not schema (A-19).

nodes.label: travel_segments
nodes.rationale: Arrivals and departures. guest_id; family_group_id nullable when entered for the whole group; direction arrival/departure/internal; mode flight/train/car/bus/other; carrier; reference_number; from/to_location; scheduled_at/actual_at; status planned/confirmed/arrived/delayed/cancelled; booked_by guest/client/ampm; ticket_document_id.

nodes.label: vehicles
nodes.rationale: Transport fleet per project. vendor_assignment_id nullable; vehicle_type; registration_number; seat_capacity; driver_name; driver_phone (restricted); status planned/available/in_service/released.

nodes.label: transfers
nodes.rationale: Transport runs. vehicle_id nullable; transfer_type airport_pickup/airport_drop/venue_shuttle/other; pickup/drop_location; scheduled_at; actual_departure/arrival_at; status planned/assigned/en_route/completed/cancelled; coordinator_user_id.

nodes.label: transfer_passengers
nodes.rationale: Manifest rows: transfer_id, guest_id, travel_segment_id nullable, status assigned/boarded/no_show.

nodes.label: guest_departures
nodes.rationale: Closure evidence that every staying guest has checked out and left. room_allocation_id and transfer_id nullable; checked_out_at; departure_confirmed; confirmed_by. Read by the closure checklist item 'departures'.

nodes.label: lost_and_found_items
nodes.rationale: Items logged on site. function_id nullable; description; found_at; found_location; found_by_user_id; photo_media_id; status logged/claimed/returned/disposed; claimed_by_guest_id; returned_at. Closure requires no logged or claimed items remain.

nodes.label: menus
nodes.rationale: Versioned menus per function. title CLIENT; caterer_assignment_id nullable; service_style buffet/plated/live_counters/mixed; status draft/shared/approved/final; client_visible.

nodes.label: menu_versions
nodes.rationale: Menu versions. version_number; status draft/shared/revision_requested/approved/superseded; submitted_by/at; approval_id; document_id; notes.

nodes.label: menu_items
nodes.rationale: Dishes. course; name and description CLIENT; dietary_tags_json veg/jain/vegan/gluten_free/contains_nuts; is_live_counter; sort_order.

nodes.label: menu_headcounts
nodes.rationale: Dietary headcounts for caterers (GP-24). dietary_category; expected_count from attendance and dietary preference (A-7) keeps moving; guaranteed_count is the commercial commitment given to the caterer; calculated_at. A snapshot recalculated when attendance changes and frozen when the guaranteed number is sent.

nodes.label: tasks
nodes.rationale: Accountability and milestones. project_id nullable (global tasks allowed); function_id nullable; owner_user_id; due_at; priority low/normal/high/urgent; status not_started/in_progress/blocked/completed/cancelled; is_milestone shown on the client dashboard; client_visible for pending decisions the client must act on; blocked_reason; related entity_type/entity_id; checklist_item_id nullable.

nodes.label: task_dependencies
nodes.rationale: task_id depends on depends_on_task_id; dependency_type finish_to_start.

nodes.label: staff_assignments
nodes.rationale: On-site rosters (GP-30). function_id nullable; user_id; on_site_role function_lead/hospitality_desk/vendor_liaison/transport/floater; shift_start/end; status planned/confirmed/on_duty/off_duty/cancelled.

nodes.label: incidents
nodes.rationale: Event-day issues and escalation. function_id nullable; reported_by/at; severity low/medium/high/critical; category guest/vendor/venue/safety/transport/other; status open/assigned/in_progress/escalated/resolved/closed; assigned_user_id; escalated_to_user_id/escalated_at; resolution_notes required before resolved when severity is critical (SPEC §7); client_visible default false. Escalation rules (e.g. escalate to the project lead after 15 minutes unassigned) live in configurations.

nodes.label: documents
nodes.rationale: Files with versions. project_id and account_id nullable; owner_type/owner_id (the record the file belongs to); document_type proposal/contract/invoice/design/menu/schedule/rooming_list/rider/ticket/consent/other; storage_key RESTRICTED in private object storage; mime_type; size_bytes; checksum; version_number and previous_version_id (self-reference supersedes); visibility internal/client/guest/public; uploaded_by; retention_class and retention_until (A-17).

nodes.label: media_assets
nodes.rationale: Images and videos with rights. owner_type hotel/destination/vendor/design_version/invitation_version/project/cms; kind image/video; storage_key RESTRICTED; thumbnail_key; caption; sort_order; visibility internal/client/demo/public; rights_status owned/licensed/consent_required/consent_obtained (GP-20); consent_source_project_id (the wedding the media came from); consent_document_id; uploaded_by. Hotel galleries and vendor portfolios live here.

nodes.label: identity_documents
nodes.rationale: Conditional identity capture (A-8, GP-41). document_type passport/voter_id/driving_licence/other, Aadhaar excluded; masked_reference last four characters only; issuing_country; expiry_date; file_document_id stored in the restricted bucket; purpose hotel_checkin/visa/travel; consent_at; collected_by null when uploaded by the guest; retention_until nullable, set only when AMPM approves deletion (Q8, Q17); deletion_approved_by. Never in exports; every read is a restricted_read audit event.

nodes.label: document_access_links
nodes.rationale: Short-lived signed download links, never permanent paths (SPEC §10, §12). token_hash RESTRICTED; expires_at; max_downloads; download_count; created_by; revoked_at.

nodes.label: checklist_templates
nodes.rationale: template_key function_readiness / project_closure; entity_type function/project; items_json ordered items with is_required; is_active.

nodes.label: checklists
nodes.rationale: Instantiated checklist. template_id; entity_type function/project with entity_id; status not_started/in_progress/blocked/complete/complete_with_exception. One per function (readiness) and one per project (closure).

nodes.label: checklist_items
nodes.rationale: item_key e.g. departures, lost_and_found, vendor_completion, final_accounts; is_required; status pending/done/not_applicable/exception; completed_by/at; exception_reason; exception_authorised_by (must hold the readiness-exception permission); evidence_document_id.

nodes.label: client_feedback
nodes.rationale: Post-wedding feedback (A-24, GP-29). submitted_by_user_id; overall_rating; comments_text; consent_to_publish; submitted_at.

nodes.label: cms_pages
nodes.rationale: Public website pages, not built (Q12). slug UK home/how_it_works/services/about/contact; status draft/published; sections_json; seo_title/description; published_at.

nodes.label: cms_showcase_items
nodes.rationale: Public website showcase, not built (Q12). media_asset_id; destination_id and hotel_id nullable; source_project_id nullable for consent (GP-20); is_published; sort_order.

nodes.label: conversations
nodes.rationale: Live chat threads (Q20). account_id; project_id nullable (subscriber conversations have no project); subject; status open/waiting_on_client/closed; assigned_user_id nullable; last_message_at; closed_at. Never carries an approval.

nodes.label: messages
nodes.rationale: Chat messages, CLIENT class on both sides. sender_type client/staff/system; sender_id; body; attachment_document_id nullable; client_request_id set when a message is turned into a tracked request; read_at.

nodes.label: A-1 Platform form factor (Q1)
nodes.rationale: Default: responsive web application with one backend for team workspace, client portal and guest portal; no native apps in v1; Phase 4 adds installable PWA mode with read-only offline caching of run-of-show and checklists. AMPM 2026-10-25 changed: native iOS and Android apps with offline use from launch; the web remains for the public website; whether the client portal also needs a web version is open. Schema impact: native apps change nothing except adding a device_tokens table for push notifications; the offline change queue is a client-side store mirrored by audit_events on sync.

nodes.label: A-2 Payment path (Q2)
nodes.rationale: Default: Phase 1 supports both an online gateway (webhook-driven activation) and offline payment recorded manually by Finance; both create a payments row; subscription activation keys off payments.status = succeeded. AMPM changed: online payment only, by card or UPI, after AMPM creates or invites the account and the client enters basic wedding details; gateway to be selected; manual recording stays as a staff fallback. Offline-only would leave provider/provider_ref unused; online-only disables method = bank_transfer.

nodes.label: A-3 Plans, trial and demo (Q3)
nodes.rationale: Default: plans supports one-time fixed-term and recurring billing; v1 configured one-time fixed-term with manual renewal; trial is subscription status trial on a plan with trial_days; demo is a plan flagged is_demo on an account flagged is_demo; entitlements come from plan_modules. AMPM confirmed: Rs 50,000, one-time, one month, configurable; renewal is a new purchase; no separate trial plan, the demo serves that purpose. Recurring billing would need subscription_invoices and dunning states; auto_renew and ends_at already exist.

nodes.label: A-4 Margin and client-facing amounts (Q4)
nodes.rationale: Default: AMPM may earn a margin on vendor and hotel pricing, so every commercial record stores client-facing amounts and internal cost in separate columns (vendor_proposals, hotel_proposals, budget_lines, room_blocks, project_final_accounts). Clients see estimates, approved amounts, invoices issued to them, their own payments and outstanding milestones; never vendor quotes, internal cost, margin, vendor invoices or vendor contracts. AMPM partly decided: internal cost and margin never shown confirmed; wedding management fee set outside the app; online milestone payment out of the first release; which client-facing amounts the portal shows still to be confirmed. A transparent fee model would need no structural change.

nodes.label: A-5 Client users per wedding (Q5)
nodes.rationale: Default: several client users per wedding through project_members with project_role client_owner / client_approver / client_viewer; can_view_finance flag; approvals need one decision by default, approvals.required_decisions allows more. AMPM changed: two family representatives, one per side, with equal rights; no viewer role and no finance flag; shared or separate logins to be decided, separate recommended.

nodes.label: A-6 Roles and cost visibility (Q6)
nodes.rationale: Default: the eleven SPEC §6 roles adopted as global staff roles plus external roles (client via project membership, guest via token, demo prospect). Internal cost and margin readable by Super Admin and Finance everywhere, the Wedding Project Manager on assigned projects, the Vendor Coordinator for vendor-side cost and the Hotel team for hotel-side cost. AMPM partly decided: department-based access confirmed; final role list and who may see hotel and vendor costs to be confirmed. Role changes alter roles and role_permissions seed data only.

nodes.label: A-7 Guest list and RSVP model (Q7)
nodes.rationale: Default: guest list loaded first (client upload or AMPM entry); each family group receives a unique tokenised RSVP link; guests respond per person per function; a group may add accompanying members up to family_groups.max_additional_guests (default 0); no open registration; dietary preference for everyone, allergies and accessibility optional and SENSITIVE; client sees own guest list except RESTRICTED and identity fields. AMPM changed: links per side or one combined link (final structure open); guests identify themselves against the loaded list; no editing after submission; corrections through the RSVP team; per-person counting, meal preference and allergies confirmed; family representatives see summaries only and cannot edit the list. A shared wedding link needs self-identification and a de-duplication queue, with rsvp_tokens.family_group_id nullable.

nodes.label: A-8 Identity documents (Q8)
nodes.rationale: Default: collected only when a project enables it for a defined purpose (hotel check-in); Aadhaar numbers never stored; accepted passport, voter ID, driving licence; files in a separate restricted bucket; retention_until defaults to checkout plus 30 days; every read audited. AMPM partly decided: per wedding, no Aadhaar and restricted storage confirmed; automatic deletion removed; retention follows AMPM-approved policy, to be confirmed. If Aadhaar is legally needed, add document_type = aadhaar_masked after legal review.

nodes.label: A-9 Hotel commercials and availability (Q9)
nodes.rationale: Default: indicative rate cards with line items (room rate by category, venue rental, per-plate minimums, taxes), client-visible once verified; negotiated rates in hotel_proposals with client and internal amounts; availability checked manually per enquiry, no calendar; per-asset media rights; hotels bulk-imported through import_jobs. AMPM confirmed and extended: prices are indicative ranges including wedding package ranges and per-plate pricing, menu grids, street view; Eva updates about three times a year; about 200 hotels at the start. A live calendar would add hotel_availability_days.

nodes.label: A-10 Phase 1 scope (Q10)
nodes.rationale: Default: Phase 1 includes demo/trial, the full ten-status hotel enquiry flow, online payment and a minimal built-in CMS; phase tags per table in §19. AMPM changed: first release includes discovery, wedding management, vendors, client portal, department access, RSVP, requests, live chat and offline operations; excludes website editing, online milestone payments and GST invoicing; single or staged launch to be agreed.

nodes.label: A-11 Notification channels (Q11)
nodes.rationale: Default: in-app, email and WhatsApp (via a business service provider) with SMS fallback, enumerated in notifications.channel. AMPM partly decided: email and WhatsApp required, SMS proposed, providers to be confirmed; live chat added. Unused channels are disabled in configuration.

nodes.label: A-12 Built-in CMS (Q12)
nodes.rationale: Default: minimal built-in CMS (cms_pages, cms_showcase_items) for destinations, showcase items and page copy. AMPM dropped it: no website editing in the app; the website is maintained outside the platform. A headless CMS would replace the two tables with an integration.

nodes.label: A-13 Authentication (Q13)
nodes.rationale: Default: clients sign in with email and password, phone OTP optional second factor; staff must use email, password and an authenticator app (TOTP); guests use token links only and never have accounts. AMPM changed: prospects, demo users and clients sign in with mobile number and OTP; staff method to be finalised (authenticator recommended). Phone-OTP-only makes users.password_hash nullable and adds an OTP flow on auth_tokens.

nodes.label: A-14 Hosting (Q14)
nodes.rationale: Default: hosted in an Indian region with private object storage; no schema impact, noted so retention and residency rules are consistent. AMPM still open: hosting to be confirmed with the developer.

nodes.label: A-15 Sizing (Q15)
nodes.rationale: Default sizing for index and partition choices: up to 50 staff users, 40 concurrent projects, 1,500 guests per project, 500 hotels, 2 TB of media in year one. AMPM changed: about 200 hotels and 20 concurrent weddings; staff and guest capacity to be confirmed. Larger volumes change indexing and partitioning (audit_events, notifications, guest_function_attendance), not the model.

nodes.label: A-16 Currency, GST, language, time zone (Q16)
nodes.rationale: Default: single currency INR with a currency column wherever money appears; GST fields on invoices and invoice lines; English only; time zone per project, default Asia/Kolkata. AMPM confirmed INR and English; the platform does not issue GST invoices, so GST fields are dormant. Multi-currency would add exchange-rate snapshots on payments and budget_lines.

nodes.label: A-17 Retention (Q17)
nodes.rationale: Default retention classes: closed leads 24 months; guest personal data 12 months after project close; identity documents checkout plus 30 days; demo data reset on a schedule; retention_class and retention_until on documents and identity_documents, client_access_until on wedding_projects. AMPM changed: no automatic deletion; retention and deletion require AMPM approval; periods to be confirmed; jobs become proposed deletion lists awaiting approval.

nodes.label: A-18 Several hotels and venues per wedding (Q18)
nodes.rationale: Default: a wedding may use several hotels (project_hotels) and venues outside the database (external_venues); wedding_projects.primary_hotel_id is a convenience pointer only. AMPM confirmed multiple hotels and venues per wedding.

nodes.label: A-19 Room blocks and allocations (Q19)
nodes.rationale: Default: room blocks held per project, hotel, room category and date range; allocations reference a block; occupants are individual guests, children included; sharing rules not enforced by the schema. AMPM confirmed: room blocks by hotel, category and dates; team-managed allocation; room-wise and person-wise counts, children included. Rules such as two adults per room become validations.

nodes.label: A-20 Chat versus tracked questions (Q20)
nodes.rationale: Default: no free-form chat in v1; a client question is a client_requests row of type question with a threaded comments trail, logged and visible to the assigned team. AMPM changed: live chat is required in addition to tracked requests, adding conversations and messages.

nodes.label: A-21 Change requests (Q21)
nodes.rationale: Default: change requests are client_requests of type change_request with the §11 statuses; a configurable threshold marks a request is_material. AMPM confirmed, with a closed status added. A separate table only if the workflow diverges from questions.

nodes.label: A-22 No vendor or hotel logins (Q22)
nodes.rationale: Default: vendors and hotels never log in; users.user_type has no vendor value. AMPM confirmed. A vendor portal later adds a vendor user type scoped to vendor_assignments; vendors unchanged.

nodes.label: A-23 Post-closure client access (Q23)
nodes.rationale: Default: clients keep read-only portal access for 12 months after closure (wedding_projects.client_access_until), then the project is archived. AMPM changed: three months of read-only access, then archiving on AMPM approval. The period is configuration.

nodes.label: A-24 Feedback and archive (Q24)
nodes.rationale: Default: post-wedding feedback is a client_feedback row; archive is wedding_projects.archived_at plus retention jobs. AMPM confirmed feedback form and archived state.

nodes.label: A-25 Material change thresholds (Q25)
nodes.rationale: Default: a change is material when it exceeds configurable thresholds (e.g. a budget line delta of 10 percent or a date or venue change); material changes set is_material and populate impact_flags_json, which drives the SPEC §8 automation. AMPM partly decided: configurable thresholds confirmed; values and approval rules to be defined.

nodes.label: A-26 Function status versus readiness (AM-3)
nodes.rationale: functions.status (planned, confirmed, cancelled) and functions.readiness_status are two fields; readiness is derived from the function's checklist. AMPM confirmed the readiness rule; the two fields stand. Could merge into one field if AMPM prefers.

nodes.label: A-27 Room category capacity (AM-5)
nodes.rationale: hotel_room_categories.room_count is the inventory in that category; max_occupancy is per room. Not addressed by AMPM; stands.

nodes.label: A-28 Demo data isolation (AM-8)
nodes.rationale: Default: demo data lives in the same database, isolated by client_accounts.is_demo, wedding_projects.is_demo and hotels.demo_visible; demo accounts see a curated subset of real hotels with rate items masked and one sample project. AMPM changed: demo shows up to three locations and one or two sample hotels each with indicative prices and street view, after OTP; limits and duration configurable and to be finalised. A separate demo database would remove the flags and add a copy job.

nodes.label: A-29 Subscription scope (AM-9)
nodes.rationale: A subscription belongs to an account and covers every project on that account. Not addressed by AMPM; stands. Per-wedding subscriptions would add subscriptions.project_id.

nodes.label: A-30 Single tenant (AM-14)
nodes.rationale: Single tenant (AMPM only); no organisation_id column anywhere. AMPM confirmed: for AMPM's internal use, not for licensing. If AMPM intends to license the software, add organisation_id to every root table before build; it is expensive to retrofit.

nodes.label: Entitlement resolution
nodes.rationale: GP-1: an active or trial subscription gives the plan_modules of its plan; an active service_agreements row gives its service's module; an active project_members row gives wedding_workspace for that project regardless of subscription state. Expiry removes the subscription modules and nothing else. Full table in permission matrix §3.

nodes.label: Lead to account conversion
nodes.rationale: A lead converts into a client_accounts row and keeps its history. A demo request is a lead with requested_demo = true and a lead_activities row of type demo once access is granted.

nodes.label: Hotel assistance commercial flow (GP-5)
nodes.rationale: The client's request creates a hotel_enquiries row. If AMPM charges for it, Sales creates a service_agreements row that points back to the enquiry; work beyond availability checking waits for status = active.

nodes.label: One payments table with direction and counterparty
nodes.rationale: payments carries a direction and a counterparty so one table serves subscription receipts, milestone receipts, vendor payouts and refunds; client_visible is true only for inbound client payments (GP-17, A-4).

nodes.label: Hotel data freshness rule
nodes.rationale: hotel_verifications is the source of truth; hotels.last_verified_at and hotel_rate_cards.status = stale are maintained by a scheduled job using configurations.hotel_verification_max_age_days (SPEC §8). A rate card whose verification is older than the configured age is shown with a stale label and its items are never presented as confirmed (SPEC §12).

nodes.label: Availability answered per enquiry, no calendar
nodes.rationale: GP-9, A-9: availability is not stored as a calendar. hotel_verifications.field_group = availability records when AMPM last confirmed general availability for a season; date-specific availability is answered inside a hotel_enquiries row. A live calendar would add hotel_availability_days.

nodes.label: Previous wedding media require consent (GP-20)
nodes.rationale: Previous wedding media are media_assets with owner_type = hotel, rights_status = consent_obtained and consent_source_project_id set; the permission matrix publishing rule refuses client or public visibility without it. hotel_wedding_references carry a consent_document_id from the referenced client.

nodes.label: An enquiry is never a booking
nodes.rationale: SPEC §7: hotel_enquiries.status = confirmed is reached only when a booking_milestones row of type confirmed is completed and a contract exists. The client sees the enquiry status, notes_client, non-internal events, site visit dates, their own feedback and proposals in shared or later status with client amounts only.

nodes.label: Pre-project records back-filled to the project (GP-27)
nodes.rationale: When a project is created later, hotel_enquiries.project_id, saved_hotels.project_id and service_agreements.project_id are back-filled for the account.

nodes.label: Project is the parent of every wedding record
nodes.rationale: SPEC §15. Creating a project requires only name, account and a tentative date range (SPEC §5). wedding_projects.status is project-level and does not replace function, task or readiness statuses (SPEC §7). Moving to closed requires the closure checklist complete and the final account approved.

nodes.label: Post-closure client access window
nodes.rationale: client_access_until is set at closure to closed_at plus the configured window (three months after Q23, A-23). After it passes, client members are set to removed by a retention job; the records remain. Archiving happens on AMPM approval (archived_at, archived_by).

nodes.label: Two schedules on purpose: programme versus run-of-show
nodes.rationale: function_programme_items is the shared programme the client and guests may see (SPEC §2.3 shared schedules); run_of_show_items is the internal cue sheet with owners, vendors and actual times (SPEC §2.4).

nodes.label: Readiness status derived from the checklist
nodes.rationale: functions.readiness_status is recalculated whenever a checklist_items row changes: ready when every required item is done or exception; blocked when any item is flagged blocked by its owner; live and completed are set by the project manager on the day. A function cannot reach ready until every is_required item is done or carries an exception authorised by a user holding the readiness-exception permission (SPEC §7).

nodes.label: Function workspace is a filtered view
nodes.rationale: Budget lines, vendor assignments, menus, design items, tasks, incidents and production items all reference functions.id optionally, so a function's workspace is a filtered view of those tables rather than a separate structure.

nodes.label: Three client-facing amounts, two internal
nodes.rationale: The client sees estimate_amount, approved_amount and actual_amount of budget lines flagged client_visible. Internal cost columns are never serialised to a client session; the API uses separate response models per audience rather than filtering one model (SPEC §4 security note). Variance (SPEC §9) is actual_amount - approved_amount for the client view and internal_cost_actual - internal_cost_estimate internally; it is a report, not a column.

nodes.label: Invoices split by direction, not dual amounts (GP-17)
nodes.rationale: An invoice issued to the client is a client document; invoices received from vendors and hotels are internal cost evidence. This closes the leak path noted in audit GP-17. GST fields (tax_rate, tax_amount, GSTIN, HSN/SAC) exist so the platform could issue compliant invoices, but after Q16 they are optional and unused.

nodes.label: Vendor options presented to the client
nodes.rationale: Presenting a vendor creates a vendor_assignments row with status = option and presented_at set. Five to ten options per category is a guideline, not a constraint (SPEC §12). The client_decision field (none/interested/shortlisted/selected/declined) records the family's response.

nodes.label: Quotes are internal, proposals are client-facing
nodes.rationale: vendor_quotes are what vendors send AMPM and are internal. vendor_proposals are what AMPM shows the client, versioned, with a client amount and an internal cost (A-4). A proposal's approval_id points at the approval that locked that exact version.

nodes.label: Vendor contact details restricted
nodes.rationale: Vendor contact details are restricted because clients deal with vendors through AMPM (BIZ §2.C). If AMPM wants selected vendors' contacts shared after selection, vendor_assignments.share_contact allows it per assignment in an AMPM-approved case (Q4, Q22; open question §21.2).

nodes.label: Approvals lock exact versions
nodes.rationale: An approval references record_type, record_id and version_number. Creating a new version of the record marks the earlier approval superseded and requires a new one. Revisions never overwrite an approved version (SPEC §12).

nodes.label: Multiple approvers (AM-7)
nodes.rationale: required_decisions on the approval and one approval_decisions row per approver. The approval becomes approved when the count of approved decisions reaches required_decisions; a single rejected or revision_requested decision moves it to that status. Both family representatives can approve (Q5).

nodes.label: Offline decisions recorded on behalf of the client
nodes.rationale: When the family approves on a call, staff record the decision with recorded_on_behalf_by and attach evidence_document_id; the audit log shows it was not the client's own click.

nodes.label: Material change requests raise impact flags
nodes.rationale: A material client request (A-25) sets is_material and populates impact_flags_json, raising flags on budgets, contracts, tasks and run-of-show items as SPEC §8 requires; thresholds such as material_change_threshold_pct live in configurations.

nodes.label: The guest is the atomic record (GP-13)
nodes.rationale: Headcounts are counted from guest_function_attendance rows, so children and accompanying members are real guests rows, not a party_count. A self-service submission and an AMPM-assisted phone response both write guest_function_attendance and append an rsvp_responses snapshot, achieving 'the same guest database without duplicates' (SPEC §12).

nodes.label: Tokenised RSVP links
nodes.rationale: Originally one token per family group (A-7, AM-1): the RSVP portal shows the group's members and the functions each is invited to. After Q7 rsvp_tokens.link_scope allows household, side or wedding links; guests on side or wedding links identify themselves against the loaded list (guests.identification_status) and responses are locked after submission. Accompanying members: a group may add up to max_additional_guests rows with source = self_added; unknown guests cannot create themselves otherwise.

nodes.label: Dietary and sensitive guest data handling (GP-24)
nodes.rationale: dietary_preference feeds menu_headcounts. allergies_text and accessibility_needs are SENSITIVE: visible to RSVP, hospitality and project-management staff on that project and to the client owner, never in exports by default (SPEC §9). Allergies are never listed per guest to a caterer; hospitality handles them through guest_support_requests of type dietary.

nodes.label: Attendance changes drive downstream flags
nodes.rationale: Attendance changes recalculate function totals and raise flags on menus, room allocations and transfers (SPEC §8) through the automation listed in permission matrix §8. menu_headcounts is a snapshot recalculated when attendance changes and frozen when the guaranteed number is sent to the caterer.

nodes.label: Room blocks before allocations (GP-11)
nodes.rationale: A room_allocations row that references a block is validated against rooms_blocked - rooms_released for its dates. Ad hoc rooms with no block are allowed but flagged in the rooming report. Change history comes from audit_events; no separate history table. Manifests (SPEC §9) are reports over travel_segments joined to transfer_passengers and room_allocation_occupants.

nodes.label: Dashboards are queries, not tables
nodes.rationale: Overdue tasks, unconfirmed vendors, unpaid milestones and incomplete readiness checks are dashboard queries over existing tables (SPEC §8); compare-hotels is a view over saved_hotels; variance and manifests are reports; no extra tables are needed.

nodes.label: Document access follows the owning record
nodes.rationale: Reading a document requires permission on owner_type/owner_id; visibility further narrows it. Download URLs are short-lived signed links (document_access_links), never permanent paths (SPEC §10, §12).

nodes.label: Media rights gate visibility (GP-20)
nodes.rationale: Only rights_status = owned, licensed or consent_obtained may be set to client, demo or public visibility; the API rejects the rest.

nodes.label: Identity documents in a restricted bucket
nodes.rationale: A-8: identity documents live in a separate restricted bucket with its own key, are never included in exports, and every read writes an audit_events row with action = restricted_read. A retention job deletes the file and nulls file_document_id after retention_until, which after Q17 is set only when AMPM approves deletion.

nodes.label: Closure checklist items backed by data
nodes.rationale: SPEC §7, §12: the project-closure checklist's required items are backed by data: departures checks guest_departures; lost_and_found checks no logged or claimed items remain; vendor_completion checks every active vendor_assignments row has completion_confirmed_at; final_accounts checks project_final_accounts.status = approved. The project moves to closed only when the checklist is complete or complete_with_exception.

nodes.label: Public website reads only public content
nodes.rationale: The public website reads only cms_pages, published cms_showcase_items, destinations with public_visible = true and hotels with public_showcase = true, and only their PUBLIC fields. The private hotel database is never queried by public pages (BIZ §2.A). The enquiry form writes to leads; the demo request sets requested_demo = true.

nodes.label: Chat versus tracked requests
nodes.rationale: A conversation never carries an approval. 'Turn into a request' creates a client_requests row with the message as its description and links back through messages.client_request_id, so the formal history stays on the request. Staff see conversations for the accounts and projects they may reach; the two family representatives see their own account's conversations. Messages are CLIENT class on both sides; internal staff notes stay in comments with is_internal.

nodes.label: Offline change queue mirrored by audit events
nodes.rationale: Q1 native apps with offline use require no table changes; an offline change queue is a client-side store, mirrored by audit_events on sync (architecture §0a).

hyperedges.label: Versioned records immutable once shared and locked by approvals (§1, SPEC §12)
Tables using polymorphic owner/entity/record references with a type check constraint (§1)
Project closure checklist items backed by data (§17)
